### ✨ Etheria: Restart Mod Menu (v2.0.4)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Activate Pro God Preset** — Enables God Mode, 1-Hit Kill, No Cooldowns & Infinite SP in 1 tap
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Player units (side=1) take 0 HP damage & cannot die
- **Defense Multiplier** — Multiplies player defence stat & divides incoming damage
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — Multiplies damage dealt to enemy units (side=2) by 99999x
- **Damage Multiplier** — Scales all outgoing skill & attack damage against enemies
- **Attack Stat Multiplier** — Multiplies player base Attack stat (get_property_value)
- **No Skill Cooldowns** — Player character & animus skills have 0 turn cooldown
- **Infinite SP / Energy** — Player SP never decreases and stays topped up in battle
- **Instant Full Heal Party** — Restores all player units' HP to 100% max immediately
- **Instant Kill All Enemies** — Drops all active enemy units' HP to 0 immediately
- **Dump Lua Scripts** — Dumps loaded Lua 5.3 bytecode to Documents/earth/dump/
- **Log Lua Scripts** — Prints loaded Lua chunk names & sizes to system console
- **Scan Lua Battle Functions** — Exports loaded modules & hooked methods to Documents/earth/scan.txt
- **Reload Custom inject.lua** — Hot-reloads Documents/earth/inject.lua without restarting
- **Check UnLua Hook Status** — Displays active lua_State pointer & UnLua call counter

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
